full_prompt_en: A square miniature-style palace landscape shows a long white domed complex above a deep green lake and terraced gardens. The view is wide and elevated, making the architecture stretch nearly from one side of the upper middle to the other. Two prominent warm gold domes rise from the central roofs, surrounded by smaller turrets, arcades, and pale parapets. Behind them, a continuous dark green tree line separates the buildings from a light blue sky filled with small cream clouds. In front of the palace, garden terraces descend in stacked horizontal bands of ochre walls, dark cypress forms, and closely planted trees. A few smaller domed pavilions appear among the greenery at the middle right. The lake occupies the lower middle, its still dark teal surface broken by small islands, embankments, and faint warm reflections. In the foreground, brown stone and dense trees frame the water; tiny light-colored figures stand near a terrace or walkway at the lower right. The intricate scene is painted with tiny precise strokes and fine outlines, so windows, leaves, and masonry remain distinct despite their scale. Colors are warm cream, gold, brick, olive, and rich teal, with a slight aged-paper softness over the whole surface. Clear daylight from the upper left brightens domes and upper walls, while tree clusters and lower terraces provide dark green shadow. The overall composition is orderly and abundant, balancing a monumental horizontal palace with layered garden detail and reflective water.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形细密画式宫殿风景，漫长的白色圆顶建筑群坐落在深绿湖泊与层叠庭园上方。视角宽广且较高，建筑在上方中部几乎从一侧延到另一侧。两个显眼的暖金圆顶从中央屋顶升起，周围是更小的塔、拱廊和浅色矮墙。其后，连绵深绿树线把建筑与布满小奶油色云的浅蓝天空分开。宫殿前方，庭园台地以赭色墙、深柏树形与密植树木组成的横带逐层降低。中右部绿意间还有几座更小的圆顶亭阁。湖泊占据下方中部，平静深青绿水面被小岛、堤岸和淡暖倒影打断。前景棕石与密树框住湖水；右下方露台或步道旁站着几位浅色小人。繁复场景以微小精确笔触和细轮廓绘成，使窗、叶与石构虽小却各自可辨。色彩是暖奶油、金、砖色、橄榄和浓青绿，整体表面略带旧纸柔感。清亮日光从左上方照亮圆顶与上层墙面，树团和下层台地提供深绿阴影。整体构图有序而丰盛，以宏大的横向宫殿平衡层叠庭园细节与反光水面。
style_prompt_en: The miniature painting uses meticulous fine outlines, tiny repeated strokes, and a densely tiered panoramic arrangement. Cream, gold, brick, olive, deep green, and teal occupy carefully bounded areas, with small warm highlights distributed across the upper planes. Repeated domelike curves and narrow vertical accents sit within long horizontal terraces, producing a formal rhythmic grid. Trees, masonry, and water are individually textured at small scale, yet broad color bands keep the composition legible. Slightly aged paper softness tempers the crisp detail. Clear daylight lifts pale upper surfaces and leaves lower foliage in rich shadow. The overall effect is ornate, serene, and expansive.
style_prompt_zh: 细密画使用精密细轮廓、微小重复笔触与密集分层的全景安排。奶油、金、砖色、橄榄、深绿和青绿占据谨慎划分的区域，小暖高光散在上表面。重复的圆顶状曲线和窄竖向强调置于长横向台地之中，形成正式节奏网格。树、石构和水在小尺度上各有肌理，宽阔色带仍使构图可读。轻微旧纸柔感缓和了清晰细节。清亮日光提亮浅色上表面，下层枝叶留在浓深阴影中。整体效果华丽、宁静而开阔。
theme_en: A domed white palace above a green lake and terraced gardens
theme_zh: 圆顶白色宫殿俯瞰绿湖与层叠庭园
name: Kishangarh painting
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
